discards.claim: The driver's own GPS trace supports an in-geofence run of only 255 seconds: five consecutive qualifying fixes from 23:42:21 to 23:46:36, against the 480-second AIRPORT minimum POL-NS-01(c) sets — 225 seconds short. Even crediting him with the entire unobserved interval through to the 23:49:05 cancellation, the export's face-value reading is 404 seconds, still 76 seconds short, as the pre-pass notes. This artifact is impaired and I say so: weight 0.25, issue codes CLOCK_SKEW (228 s), GPS_GAP (186 s sitting across the moment of geofence entry), LOW_COVERAGE (22.8%), TRUNCATED_LOG (trace stops 149 s before the terminal event), LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD. The discount does not repair the shortfall — the 186-second gap that conceals the entry moment is precisely why entry cannot be credited earlier, and after 23:46:36 the trace shows no in-geofence fix at all.
discards.detail: the claim cites impaired artifact EV-TRIP-00210 at weight_multiplier 0.4 but does not name its issue code(s): CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT

discards.claim: The one route by which a short in-geofence run could be lengthened is closed on this record. EV-ADVIS-00210-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0 (issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) — no advisory covers the Changi T1 arrival kerb in this window — and its absence is itself citable. POL-NS-06(i) requires a traffic_advisory that is present and populated before separate in-geofence intervals may be summed, so the accumulated-dwell computation is unavailable and the driver's time stands at the 255 seconds the trace records. Nothing may be added to it.
discards.detail: the claim cites impaired artifact EV-GPS-00210 at weight_multiplier 0.25 but does not name its issue code(s): CLOCK_SKEW, GPS_GAP, LOW_COVERAGE, TRUNCATED_LOG, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE, PARTIAL_RECORD

discards.claim: POL-NS-01(b) requires the trace to place the driver inside the pickup geofence defined in POL-NS-02 at or before the timestamp of the arrived event. On the export as it stands the first qualifying in-geofence fix is stamped 23:42:21 — eleven seconds AFTER the trip record's 23:42:10 arrival event — and the trace's device clock runs 228 seconds ahead of the server, far over the 90-second limb in POL-NS-08(a), so on the pre-pass's own finding no fix can be safely matched to the arrival event. An arrival marker whose position at the marker cannot be verified does not satisfy limb (b), and the artifact's impairment (weight 0.25) is disclosed.
discards.detail: the claim cites impaired artifact EV-GPS-00210 at weight_multiplier 0.25 but does not name its issue code(s): CLOCK_SKEW, GPS_GAP, LOW_COVERAGE, TRUNCATED_LOG, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE, PARTIAL_RECORD

discards.claim: Should the judge prefer the skew-corrected reading of the trace — which would move the first in-geofence fix to 23:38:33 server time and yield a 632-second dwell — then two admissible artifacts, EV-TRIP-00210 and EV-GPS-00210, contradict each other directly on arrival and dwell (415 s against 632 s, with the 186-second gap straddling the entry moment) and no clause resolves the conflict. The only evidence for the deciding fact is then impaired under POL-NS-08(a) and (b). The outcome the record supports in that event is not a ruling against the rider but escalation under POL-NS-09(b) and POL-NS-09(e), where the disputed fee is placed on hold rather than collected or refunded, so the rider is not made to carry the charge while a human reviewer settles the open question of when the driver actually entered the geofence.

ruling.explanation:
Both parties: the SGD 6.00 Changi T1 no-show fee cannot be decided on this record. The case goes to a human reviewer and the fee is held — not collected from the rider and not refunded — while that review is pending. Escalation is terminal; it is not a win for either side.

Why. The charge stands or falls on whether the driver held position inside the Door 6 geofence for the 480 seconds an AIRPORT pickup requires, measured under POL-NS-01(c) from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix and not from the 'arrived' event. That measurement exists in only one artifact, EV-GPS-00210, and it is impaired under POL-NS-08(a) and (b): a 228-second device clock skew (over the 90-second limb), a 186-second sampling gap lying straight across the moment of geofence entry, 22.8% coverage, and a trace that stops 149 seconds before the cancellation. Read at face value the trace yields a 404-second hold, 76 seconds short; corrected for the skew it yields 632 seconds, comfortably over. The gap conceals which reading is right, and POL-NS-01(c) is measured from the very entry moment the gap swallows. POL-NS-08 provides that where the sole evidence for the deciding fact is impaired under its limbs the case escalates, and POL-NS-09(e) is engaged. POL-NS-09(b) is independently engaged: the trip record's arrived_at of 23:42:10 with its implied 6.9-minute wait and the trace contradict each other directly on arrival and dwell, and no clause resolves the conflict. POL-NS-09(a) is also engaged, because the deciding fact rests on an artifact at weight 0.25, below the 0.70 floor.

Rider's points. Your shortfall argument — 415 seconds counted from the trip record's own arrived and cancelled stamps — is not accepted: POL-NS-01(c) measures the dwell from the first qualifying GPS fix, not from the 'arrived' event, and the trip record is itself impaired for CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT at weight 0.4, so its timings cannot carry the finding. Your POL-NS-04 route is correctly not pressed: limb (a) cannot be run because your only surviving message was sent at 23:49:40, after the 23:49:05 cancellation, and limb (c) is undecidable because the trace carries no rider_track; that is neutral, not adverse, exactly as you say. Your fare point is accepted: the amount in issue is the SGD 6.00 cancellation-fee line and nothing else, and the fare breakdown is complete at weight 1.0 with payment_status PENDING and refund_issued_sgd 0.00.

Driver's points. Your POL-NS-01(a) and (d) observations (an arrived event, and a termination under RIDER_NO_SHOW at 23:49:05) are accepted so far as they go, and your anti-farming and abuse checks are correctly not triggered: no_show_terminations_30d of 2 is below 4 and 2/156 is 0.013, below the 0.08 rate limb, so POL-NS-07 withholds nothing; no_show_disputes_30d of 1 and zero counterparty disputes mean POL-NS-09(c) and (d) do not fire. But they do not get you paid. POL-NS-07 compensation presupposes POL-NS-01 satisfied in full, and limbs (b) and (c) are undecided: the trace cannot be safely matched to the arrival event through the 228-second skew, and the in-geofence dwell cannot be fixed. POL-NS-05 cannot be run for the same reason, so no false-arrival finding and no referral is entered against you. POL-NS-03 is not engaged — the driver's fixes sit inside the AIRPORT radius and the pin's venue_id is null, so no wrong-entrance allocation arises. No clause produces a referral here, so the referrals list is empty.

Open question for the reviewer: when did the driver actually enter the Door 6 geofence — the face-value 23:42:21 or the skew-corrected 23:38:33 — and did he then hold position for the full 480 seconds? The confidence of 0.25 is the weight of the sole artifact carrying the deciding fact.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
